evidence.note: The independent survey supports substantial US domestic use among teenagers. Its fieldwork overlaps the target window, but it does not measure all customer groups.

The contemporaneous company disclosure supports availability of broadly similar consumer functions. Downloads and Chinese app-store ranking do not establish active domestic customer counts or practical parity.
The company release documents contemporaneous reasoning and tool-use availability. This supports functional similarity, while its performance assertions are not independent findings.

DeepSeek's contemporaneous self-reported limitations challenge stronger technical-parity readings. One model's disadvantages do not establish a large national advantage across representative practical uses.

The independent retrospective analysis was available by the cutoff. Its multi-year benchmark lag supplies countercontext, but does not isolate the target window or measure practical product substitutability.

reviews.rationale: The packet supports US adoption and overlapping product functions. Chinese downloads do not establish active domestic use, and neither the benchmark history nor one model's limitations settles practical parity across representative tasks at publication. Partial support with unsettled remaining elements does not establish a mixed outcome.
